description: a basic bench, allows weary travelers to find rest in your garden
A curved charcoal-iron lamppost with softly glowing amber panes. Static, cosmetic decoration; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A smooth warm-grey stone birdbath with still jade water and one carved woodland bird. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A three-tined iron pitchfork with a honey-wood handle and tan wrapped grip. Static and cosmetic; no gameplay skill or base attraction.
A shell-roof woodland mailbox with leaf letters and a waiting parcel. +5% offline visitor storage capacity while placed.
A rounded straw hive on a wooden stand, with a honey pot and drinking saucer. +3% garden attraction while placed. Gentle honey drip.
A warm clay kiln with flickering green foxfire and three unfinished acorn cups on its drying shelf. Cosmetic; no gameplay skill.
A curved wooden harp with seven sky-reflecting droplets. Morning Rain gives each planted plant +2.5 water at the start of each game day.
A midnight-blue garden gnome etched with stars and nebulae. Celestial Welcome gives +4.5% garden attraction while placed.
A fungal switchboard with seed-husk receivers and traveling light pulses. Sporeline Surge gives all planted plants +4% water from workouts while placed.
A crooked wooden sign with Home, Somewhere and a scratched-out third direction. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A slumped scarecrow beneath an oversized straw hat, with one bird nesting in its pocket. Static cosmetic item. No skill.
A reel-tethered kite holds a tiny floating cloud. Gentle six-second wind loop. Gentle Hold extends butterfly welcome time by 20% while placed.
A hollow-log lending library with bark-bound books and a full-moon return sign. Borrowed Wisdom gives +1% activity water per distinct planted species, capped at +5%.
A faded blanket, a well-loved basket, and two mugs waiting for their owners. A little rest leaves room for another adventure.
